Dried fish, dried (bombil), and many varieties of fish are available there.You should also know how to negotiate the price a little while buying; otherwise, seeing a new customer, some sellers may quote very high prices. So, be careful while purchasing.

featured_reviews.name: subhro banerjee
featured_reviews.review_text: This is THE destination for all fish lovers staying around Parel. Specially if you are a bong and looking for rahu, katla and even mourula mach you should visit this fish market. When you are there every alternate buyer is a Bengali and the fish seller is a bong too. Yuu can visit this place for sea fishes too. The good time to visit is around 6.30 pm when you get the fresh fishes there. Njoy fish...

featured_reviews.name: Priyansh Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Celestia Spacious is a beautifully planned society with just two towers, giving it a calm, private feel. The amenities are top-notch: a clean swimming pool, a smooth walking track with an acupuncture path, table tennis, sauna, a small basketball zone, and a dedicated kids’ play area. The pool and indoor games like chess add a fun touch, while the amphitheater and the elegant banquet hall elevate the overall experience. The gym is genuinely impressive, and the sunset views from the property are stunning. Overall, it’s a well-equipped, peaceful, and aesthetically pleasing place to live.

featured_reviews.name: Murtaza Lakdawala
featured_reviews.review_text: Superb Society, Been living here for 3 years now and have to say that the crowd is very good and supportive. Very good and diverse society that indulges and enjoys every occasion together!
